name: OMathNary
description: Represents the mathematical n-ary object, consisting of an n-ary object, a base (or operand), and optional upper limits and lower limits.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the add-in was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified OMathNary object.

properties.name: Sub
properties.description: Returns an OMath object that represents the lower limit of an n-ary operator. Read-only.

properties.name: Sup
properties.description: Returns an OMath object that represents the upper limit of an n-ary operator. Read-only.

properties.name: E
properties.description: Returns an OMath object that represents the base of the specified equation object. Read-only.

properties.name: Char
properties.description: Returns or sets an Integer that represents a character used as the n-ary operator. Read/write.

properties.name: Grow
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean that represents whether n-ary operators grow to the full height of the arguments that they contain. Read/write.

properties.name: SubSupLim
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean that represents the positioning of n-ary limits in the subscript-superscript or upper limit-lower limit position. Read/write.

properties.name: HideSub
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean that represents whether to hide the lower limit of an n-ary operator. Read/write.

properties.name: HideSup
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean that represents whether to hide the upper limit of an n-ary operator. Read/write.
